scope: Read-only Principal review of the owned Pixi event/artifact lifecycle fix, asynchronous Application initialization ownership, stale event-fetch rejection fencing, and the source-relevance bridge from the fully hosted native backend source.

findings.queued_layout: Owner destruction cancels queued throttled work; in-flight collision work checks owner liveness after asynchronous cluster creation and cannot render or attach into the destroyed scene.
findings.subscriptions_and_late_resources: Event, artifact, wrapper, and leaf subscriptions are released by their Pixi owner. A late leaf or cluster is destroyed instead of being attached, and post-await positioning/rendering checks destruction.
findings.root_generation: Captured stage and root scope prevent an old initialization, fetch callback, or stop handle from overwriting or mutating a newer scene.
findings.event_fetch: Stopping increments the local generation, suppressing stale success, stale rejection reporting, callbacks, and poll rescheduling.
findings.application_initialization: Application remains unpublished until init completes. Stop invalidates the generation without destroying an unfinished renderer; a stale completed renderer destroys only its local instance. A newer initialization remains authoritative when the older one settles.
findings.known_boundary: Cleared historical prerequisite wait promises are not promised to settle. They cannot receive a new graph's events after emitter.clear and cannot mutate its scene; no global cancellation/rejection API, memory SLO, or performance SLO is claimed.

conditions_remaining: Source-bound final UI regression ledger, including the 36 lifecycle tests and complete UI suite, must pass on this exact manifest.
The corrected negative late-error probe and a fresh packaged eight-document post-close browser run must pass with retained timeline/error output and exact served bundle-byte evidence.
Browser/accessibility, type, lint, formatting, production build, hosted UI/static, and CodeQL checks must pass on the actual UI successor source.
ADR-0041 and the aggregate epoch verdict remain progress/pending until those records are independently reviewed; this intermediate review does not declare the full epoch accepted.
scope_limits: The accepted backend/runtime evidence remains bound to ec10b92 and is reused only through byte equality of all 143 unchanged native paths.
This review establishes local UI scene ownership and navigation teardown behavior, not a general UI memory or performance guarantee.
No Python, server, stream protocol, worker, database, retry, cursor, or deployment behavior is changed or requalified by the UI-only successor.
